parameters.help_en: The subscription period of the resource. The unit is specified by PeriodUnit
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长，单位由PeriodUnit指定
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription period. Valid values:
Month: months.
Year: years
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。
取值范围：
Month：月。
Year：年
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
false (default): generates an unpaid order without deducting fees.

If the balance of your payment method is insufficient, you can change the Settings of this parameter to false to generate an unpaid order. Then, you can log on to the WUYING Cloud Phone console to complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付。取值范围：

true：自动支付。您需要确保账户余额充足。
false（默认）：只生成订单不扣费。




如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将此参数设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录无影云手机管理控制台自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The channel cookie. This parameter is passed through to the sales system when you place an order
